description:
Implement the concrete SignatureVerifier dispatch for the RustCrypto algorithm backends. These are feature-gated in pkix-path and reused by pkix-chain-simple.

BLOCKED BY: Epic PKIX-cfh (SignatureVerifier return type must be fixed to Result<(), signature::Error> before these are implemented).

Backends to implement (behind feature flags):

rsa feature — sha256WithRSAEncryption (OID 1.2.840.113549.1.1.11):
  Use rsa::pkcs1v15::VerifyingKey<sha2::Sha256>. Extract RSA public key from SubjectPublicKeyInfoRef. Verify DER TBSCertificate bytes against signature bytes.

p256 feature — ecdsa-with-SHA256 over P-256 (OID 1.2.840.10045.4.3.2):
  Use p256::ecdsa::VerifyingKey. Parse point from SubjectPublicKeyInfoRef. Verify.

Dispatch wrapper:
  A DefaultVerifier struct (enabled when any backend feature is active) that matches on algorithm.oid and delegates to the appropriate backend, returning signature::Error for unknown OIDs. This struct is reused internally by pkix-chain-simple.

Backlog (v0.2, priority 4):
  RSA-PSS (id-RSASSA-PSS), P-384 ecdsa-with-SHA384, Ed25519 id-Ed25519.

Sub-issues to create:
1. RSA-PKCS1v15-SHA-256 backend
2. ECDSA-P256-SHA-256 backend
3. DefaultVerifier OID dispatch wrapper
4. (backlog) RSA-PSS backend
5. (backlog) P-384 backend
6. (backlog) Ed25519 backend

Acceptance: unit tests with known-good OpenSSL-signed vectors for each algorithm. Clippy clean. Feature powerset check passes.
